summary_1line: Yudhishthira honors Dhritarashtra, organizes his government, performs funeral rites and charities for the war dead, and offers a profound hymn of praise to Krishna.

image_candidates.scene_text: In the royal court, Yudhishthira formally appoints Bhima as Yuvaraja while his brothers and elders stand around the throne.
Yudhishthira and Draupadi distribute cows, jewels, and garments to crowds of Brahmanas during grand funeral offerings for the fallen heroes.
With folded hands before Krishna, Yudhishthira stands in reverence as he proclaims Krishna the cosmic lord of the universe.
